description:
Self-custodial wallet for Chihuahua Chain and the Cosmos ecosystem Huallet is the self-custodial wallet of Chihuahua Chain. Hold, send, stake, swap and vote on HUAHUA and the whole Cosmos ecosystem, with your keys encrypted on your phone. Your keys, your phone
  • Create a wallet (12 or 24 words, with verification) or import a recovery phrase or private key
  • Secrets encrypted with AES-256-GCM, key derived from your password (PBKDF2-SHA256, 600,000 iterations)
  • Optional fingerprint or face unlock: the password is kept by the phone's secure hardware (Android Keystore) and released only after a biometric check
  • Screenshots blocked, no cloud backup of wallet data, auto-lock
  • The recovery phrase is shown only after your password or biometrics
  • Ledger hardware wallets over Bluetooth (Nano X, Stax, Flex) or a USB (OTG) cable, with the Cosmos app: keys never leave the device
Everything Cosmos
  • Portfolio across chains: available, staked, rewards, unbonding
  • Staking: stake, unstake, redelegate, claim rewards
  • Swap on HuahuaSwap, Chihuahua's native DEX, and on Osmosis with the best route from the Osmosis router
  • IBC transfers, channels verified on-chain before sending
  • Governance: proposals, live tally, vote
  • Chihuahua, Cosmos Hub, Osmosis, Juno and Celestia built in; add any chain from the Cosmos chain registry
Pay and get paid
  • Scan an address or payment request QR code (in-app scanner, no Google services)
  • Tap to pay over NFC: the receiver's phone shares a payment request, the payer's phone reads it. Only the request goes over NFC, never keys or signatures
  • Tap a QR code to show it full screen at full brightness
Every transaction is shown in full before you sign. No analytics, no ads, no trackers. Network connections:
  • Public Cosmos RPC/REST endpoints of your chains
  • CoinGecko for fiat prices: on by default, can be turned off in Settings. Only token IDs are sent, never your address
  • raw.githubusercontent.com for Cosmos chain registry data (asset lists, the chains you add, IBC channels) and token icons; chains.cosmos.directory for the list of chains you can add
  • sqs.osmosis.zone for Osmosis swap quotes and raw.githubusercontent.com for the Osmosis asset list, only on the Osmosis swap tab
The icons of the built-in tokens are bundled in the app.
